source: Exact prompt/check/oracle IDs in the frozen field corpus; no added reward for builder-specific formats, word count or file count
semantic_review: Two separately instructed agents with no inherited chat context, one for create and one for audit. They see neutral bundles and case rubrics, not schedule/condition labels or raw traces. Their calibration reads included extra case definitions in the same corpus file, but no treatment assignment or output.

calibration.bare_repeated_notes_brief: Fail usable_notes_procedure; a scaffold or completion claim is insufficient
calibration.literal_mira_next_tuesday_and_independen: Pass semantic field preservation without requiring exemplar Alex/Friday words
calibration.intended_digest_correct_answer_without_a: Activation unknown and affected comparison unscored
calibration.keyword_free_valid_paraphrase: Judge by task meaning; no required meeting/fixtures/release terms
calibration.folded_description_quoted_version_compat: Valid optional metadata, not an audit defect
calibration.unsupported_100_percent_and_50_percent_c: Unsupported without host/baseline/usage evidence; not proven false or zero benefit
calibration.correct_impact_wrong_line: Substantive criterion may pass but source_locations fails
calibration.static_setup_write: Describe create/truncate path without fabricating observed execution

mechanical_review: Outside the subject: before/after hashes, allowed path changes, complete command events, forbidden attempts, native skill reads/identity, tool status and reported usage
primary_outcome: Finished within the predeclared budget plus every original task check and invariant passed. Unknown activation/clean-control identity blocks attribution; all completion failures remain visible.
secondary_outcomes: Per-check counts and material false findings
Process/evidence completeness without using template presence as a quality proxy
Tool calls/errors, reported input/cache/output tokens and observational time
uncertainty: Four cases and one trial per condition; public historical adaptations and LLM semantic grading. Blinded presentation can still reveal implementation characteristics in artifact text. No general reliability, statistical superiority or dollar-savings claim is supported.
